customManagers.description: Digest-pinned container images in the test code, marked with a `// renovate:` comment. config:recommended ignores tests/, hence the empty ignorePaths.
targetAbi in build.yaml follows Jellyfin.Controller (12.4.0 is written as "12.4.0.0"). semver, because in NuGet versioning a bare 12.4.0 is a range that newer versions already satisfy.

packageRules.description: Everything else: one weekly group, automerged when green

The Jellyfin the Plugin targets: image, NuGet packages and targetAbi in one PR, opened only once all four have moved (NuGet publishes before Docker Hub). A merged bump changes targetAbi, which cuts the patch release.
The Identity Provider the E2E tests run against
Majors always get their own PR and wait for the maintainer
